# speedy/cache

> 标签: PHP

## 简介

Cache for quick and easy caching of templates, data, or aggregation sets.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 7；已收录于 php-v7, php-v8。

## 官网

- 官网：https://packagist.org/packages/speedy%2Fcache
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/tkliner/speedy-cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/speedy%2Fcache
